chunks: Al-Mahamili narrated from Dharīḥ, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'When Allah wishes goodness for a household, He grants them moderation in livelihood and good character.'

key_terms.الرِّفْقَ: Moderation, gentleness, or ease in handling matters, specifically here regarding livelihood.
key_terms.حُسْنَ الْخُلُقِ: Good character, noble ethics, or pleasant disposition.

ai.seo_question: What are the signs of Allah's goodness for a household according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Compiled by Husayn ibn Sa'id al-Ahwazi in *Kitab al-Zuhd*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) links divine benevolence to the domestic sphere, emphasizing that true prosperity is marked by gentleness in livelihood and excellence in conduct. It reflects the Shia scholarly view that spiritual health manifests as ethical ease within the family unit, serving as a tangible sign of Allah's favor.
